description: A team of 6, Computer Science students at UNIMAS. Our team name comes from a creative combination of all the first letter of our members' surname, which happens to sound similar to “Bak Kut Teh”, a well-known Malaysian dish. We were impressed by an interactive website (https://kprverse.com/) while deciding on the challenge. Then, we decided to take this challenge and try our best to implement something similar, although what we study is more to backend while this is frontend heavy.
